female-technical-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who list specific products or goals beyond family welfare fund faster.
female-technical-specificity-faster.body: Pitches from women that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, or concrete objectives beyond general family security accelerate funding.

business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

concrete-business-details-faster.title: Pitches that provide concrete financial figures or specific inventory lists fund faster regardless of gender.
concrete-business-details-faster.body: The inclusion of specific monthly income, detailed inventory lists, or precise product types accelerates funding for both men and women.

female-child-age-faster.title: Female borrowers who list the specific ages of their children fund faster.
female-child-age-faster.body: Providing precise ages for children in the pitch text is associated with increased funding speed for women.

female-boilerplate-slower.title: Female borrowers who use generic template language fund more slowly.
female-boilerplate-slower.body: Pitches from women that utilize generic template language, such as standard greetings or boilerplate phrasing about inspiring others, are associated with slower funding speeds.

female-location-specificity-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention a specific town or city in their pitch fund faster.
female-location-specificity-faster.body: The inclusion of a specific geographic location, such as a town, city, or city center, is associated with increased funding speed for women.

female-gratitude-slower.title: Female borrowers who include explicit gratitude or thanks to lenders fund more slowly.
female-gratitude-slower.body: The inclusion of gratitude markers or expressions of thanks to the lenders in the pitch text is associated with slower funding speeds for women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

gender-technicality-interaction.body: Technical business specificity may accelerate funding for women but decelerate it for men.

female-technical-logistics-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide specific logistical or technical details, such as land size or transport, may fund more slowly.

female-smartphone-slower.body: Female borrowers requesting loans specifically for the purchase of a smartphone may fund more slowly.

female-child-photo-id-slower.body: Female borrowers who include notes identifying the children in their photos may fund more slowly.

male-verbosity-slower.body: Male borrowers who write lengthier and more detailed pitches fund more slowly.

female-land-acquisition-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention the concrete goal of buying a plot of land may fund faster.

verbosity-slower-general.body: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail may predict slower funding regardless of gender.

female-child-count-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention the specific number of children they support may fund more slowly.

female-entrepreneur-phrasing-faster.body: Female borrowers using the specific phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund faster.

female-nwtf-history-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention previous loans from NWTF may fund faster.

female-loan-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention previous loan repayment history fund faster.
female-loan-history-faster.retrospective: Retired to maintain puzzle cap for female-education-motivation-slower.

female-social-benefit-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention specific social or environmental benefits, such as children's education, may fund faster.
female-social-benefit-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentions of improving children's futures were associated with slower funding.

loan-details-faster.title: Pitches that include specific loan details, such as the lending partner and the loan amount in local currency, fund faster regardless of gender.
loan-details-faster.retrospective: Auto-retired: confidence fell below 0.35 after observation that local currency amounts were present in all slower female pitches.

male-family-focus-faster.title: Male borrowers who emphasize family quality of life fund faster than those who use technical terminology.
male-family-focus-faster.retrospective: Dropped from puzzles to make room for female-institutional-affiliation-slower.

female-institutional-affiliation-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific institutional or community affiliations may fund more slowly.

female-entrepreneur-phrasing-faster.title: Female borrowers using the specific phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund faster.
female-entrepreneur-phrasing-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for verbosity-slower-general puzzle.

female-nwtf-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention previous loans from NWTF may fund faster.
female-nwtf-history-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for female-child-count-slower puzzle.

female-husband-income-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention using income from a husband to repay the loan may fund faster.
female-husband-income-faster.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that mentioning husband's occupation is associated with slower funding.

female-education-motivation-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention their education or motivations for starting their business fund more slowly.
female-education-motivation-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for new puzzles.

female-health-risk-reduction-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention reducing health and hazard risks to the family may fund faster.
female-health-risk-reduction-faster.retrospective: Retired to make room for female-nwtf-history-faster puzzle.
